description: A three-band tone control: a low shelf, a mid peak and a high shelf, each cutting or lifting by up to 12dB

params.text: Cuts or lifts everything below 250Hz, from -12dB to 12dB, on a Butterworth shelf
Cuts or lifts a band centred on 700Hz, from -12dB to 12dB, at a Q of 0.8
Cuts or lifts everything above 2000Hz, from -12dB to 12dB, on a Butterworth shelf

outputs.text: The signal after the low shelf, the mid peak and the high shelf, applied in that order

notes: if a filter ever produces a value that is not a number the module zeroes that sample and resets all three filters, so a blown-up filter recovers by itself.
